The VWAP service is built into the compiled processor, and the scenario run published the expected seven updates. The analyser canvas has the VWAP chart, but I couldn't take a screenshot to confirm its placement.

## Published VwapUpdates

Fresh process via `./run.sh`. I read `Trade(symbol, price, qty)` in the constructor's argument order, so `Trade(A,10,100)` is price 10, qty 100.

| # | Input | Published on "vwap" | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Trade(A,10,100) | A 10.0 | First trade in A's window |
| 2 | Trade(A,20,100) | A 15.0 | (1000+2000)/200 |
| 3 | Trade(B,50,10) | B 50.0 | B's window
